metadata.label: telegram_wallet
metadata.name: Telegram Wallet
metadata.description: Telegram's native in-app wallet (WalletTg). User accounts share one trampoline contract code (code hash kUmuUcHkaJcQzr94MCl7Fqz7rbNjqSClN4k+f/7sp2g=); Telegram-operated highload wallets relay user-signed gasless requests to them. Attribution is an on-chain inference.

addresses.comment: Telegram Wallet Gas Funder — highload wallet that funded each gas relayer with 1003 TON
